name: auth-failure
description:
A 401 from the search endpoint -- a wrong or revoked API key. 401 is not on the transient retry list, so exactly one request is made, the page error is printed with the status, and the run ends cleanly with zero assets instead of aborting.

namespaced_ids is skipped for consistency with the other Maze scenarios (no assets are produced here anyway).

log_contains: Maze API error on page 1: status 401
